cleansingStrength.rationale: Strong by C5 convention: defining anionic Sodium Coco-Sulfate (3) is alkyl-sulfate type; buffers Cocamidopropyl Betaine (5), Lauryl Glucoside (6), Coco-Glucoside (24) (>=2); but Sodium Cetearyl Sulfate (19) is a prominent alkyl sulfate (assigned by its chemistry name, C3) and therefore a reinforcing route -> C5 'otherwise' -> strong. Counter-signals toward moderate: Sodium Cetearyl Sulfate is a C16-18 emulsifying sulfate paired with Cetearyl Alcohol (15), three buffers, aloe base, Sunflower Oil (11), Glycerin (4). These lower confidence to moderate but cannot move the convention value (§4).

conditioningLevel.rationale: High via C2 (payload-lipid variant): prominent payload lipid Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil (11) in place of the early silicone, cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (21), fatty route Cetearyl Alcohol (15), humectants Glycerin (4), Sodium Hyaluronate (10), Betaine (17); plus weak refatter PCA Glyceryl Oleate (16). C2 holds even in a strong chassis (C2). Counter-signal: single late guar, natural-cosmetic oil levels likely low -> neighbor moderate.
